This time the S.W.C. man stormed home ahead of Vaughan with Selby ousting Middleton from 3rd place and Vale showing Hall the way home. Surrey just had the edge and in a Surrey- Belgrave dominated championship, the Claret & Gold had to concede first place.

Bob Barnes showed some of his old fire to finish 3rd but was followed home by two S.W.C. men (Selby and Vale). Ted Smith soon followed in 8th place and then everything depended on the positioning of Wishart (SWC) and Bob Picton.
